## Checklist

- [ ] The change has one topic, and anything large was discussed in an issue first.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests, and the suites for the area I touched pass.
- [ ] `ruff check` reports nothing new in the files I changed, and I didn't reformat code I didn't change.
- [ ] If the change touches a path that changes only with a release (CONTRIBUTING.md section 4.3), I said so above.
- [ ] No tokens, pairing codes, tailnet names, addresses or other private details are in the code, the tests or the output I pasted.
- [ ] User-visible changes are described in the documentation.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), certifying the Developer Certificate of Origin.
- [ ] I can license this contribution as CONTRIBUTING.md describes: Apache-2.0 for code, AGPL-3.0-or-later for the parts that use MuPDF, CC BY 4.0 for documentation.
